title: Dispatch through a base reference
prompt: A Shape reference to a Rectangle must call Rectangle::area, returning width × height. Keep a virtual destructor because clients may delete through a base pointer. Width and height are nonnegative and the product fits int.
signature: class Shape: virtual int area() const; class Rectangle: override area()
driver: int main(){int w,h;if(!(std::cin>>w>>h))return 2;Rectangle r(w,h);const Shape& shape=r;std::cout<<shape.area()<<"\n";}

tests.label: Base reference
tests.hint: The virtual call needs derived behavior.

tests.label: Base owner
tests.hint: A base owner needs virtual dispatch and safe deletion.

hints: virtual tells C++ to select behavior using the actual object type.
override checks that the derived signature really replaces a virtual function.
explanation: The call through Shape selects Rectangle at execution. A virtual base destructor ensures the derived destructor runs if a Shape pointer owns a Rectangle.
